name: EvidenceTable
description: Exact source figures in a semantic, horizontally scrollable table with a headline, context, takeaway and footnote; one column can be highlighted.
whenToUse: When the reader needs the exact numbers behind a finding, or several measures per row (revenue, cost, margin, growth). Put it after the chart it substantiates. The brand frames the table through the tableFrame slot. NOT for a single figure (StatBand) and NOT as a substitute for a chart when a trend is the point.
